[Barely Possible 2026-05-03]

Today's episode:
• Uber burned its full annual AI coding budget by April after a December Claude Code rollout — 70% of committed code now originates from AI.
• Per-engineer spend is running $500–$2,000/month, a 50–200x jump over Copilot seats; Uber's CTO says they're "back to the drawing board."
• Qwen 3.6 27B hit 95.7% on SimpleQA with an agentic search harness on a single $700 3090, opening a real hybrid-routing escape hatch.

Hear the full breakdown in today's episode of Barely Possible.
